mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL index signals lower inflation expectations, reducing risk premium on bonds and freeing capital for equity investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not decline for 3 months, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in UNRATE below 3.0% signals improving labor market conditions, boosting growth expectations and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 3.0% within 2 months, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDPC1 (GDP) and HOUST (industrial production) signals robust demand growth, reducing uncertainty and attracting capital to equities, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST does not increase concurrently, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO during a supply disruption regime signals potential recovery in production, easing supply constraints and boosting corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not decline during supply disruption regime, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in GDPC1 above its 6-month high signals robust demand growth, reducing uncertainty and attracting capital to equities, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not exceed 19121.112 within 3 months, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in UNRATE and rise in PAYEMS signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Either UNRATE does not decline or PAYEMS does not rise concurrently, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in FEDFUNDS above 2.0% signals contractionary policy, raising interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not exceed 2.0% during tightening cycle, or returns are not significantly negative (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in GDPC1 and concurrent increase in HOUST signals robust demand growth, reducing uncertainty and attracting capital to equities, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or HOUST does not increase concurrently, or returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over 60 days.
